column1: # Candidate resistance-retaining CYP51 inhibitors for the domain-lifted pool audit (Stage 0).
# Every row is a named compound proposed as a "resistance-active" holdout member: a CYP51
# inhibitor with MEASURED activity against azole-resistant Candida auris. The audit
# (scripts/domain_lifted_pool_audit.py) decides which rows survive into the validation pool
# under the RIGID (<=45 heavy) vs DOMAIN-LIFTED (no size cap) regimes.
# Discipline (data/ligands/PROVENANCE.md, constraint #3): each SMILES is the isomeric SMILES
# copied verbatim from the PubChem record for the listed CID (NOT AI-generated), and each
# activity claim carries a primary-literature PMID. cauris_evidence = "none" means no
# C. auris-specific MIC surfaced in the 2026-08-23 literature pass -> excluded on evidence,
